globalConfiguration.name: savings-interest-posting-current-period-end
globalConfiguration.description: Recommended to be changed only once during start of production. When set as false(default), interest will be posted on the first date of next period. If set as true, interest will be posted on last date of current period. There is no difference in the interest amount posted.

globalConfiguration.name: financial-year-beginning-month
globalConfiguration.description: Recommended to be changed only once during start of production. Allowed values 1 - 12 (January - December). Interest posting periods are evaluated based on this configuration.

globalConfiguration.name: min-clients-in-group
globalConfiguration.description: Minimum number of Clients that a Group should have

globalConfiguration.name: max-clients-in-group
globalConfiguration.description: Maximum number of Clients that a Group can have

globalConfiguration.name: meetings-mandatory-for-jlg-loans
globalConfiguration.description: Enforces all JLG loans to follow a meeting schedule belonging to parent group or Center

globalConfiguration.name: office-specific-products-enabled
globalConfiguration.description: Whether products and fees should be office specific or not? This property should NOT be changed once Mifos is Live.

globalConfiguration.name: restrict-products-to-user-office
globalConfiguration.description: This should be enabled only if, products & fees are office specific (i.e. office-specific-products-enabled is enabled). This property specifies if the products should be auto-restricted to office of the user who created the proudct? Note: This property should NOT be changed once Mifos is Live.

globalConfiguration.name: rounding-mode
globalConfiguration.description: 0 - UP, 1 - DOWN, 2- CEILING, 3- FLOOR, 4- HALF_UP, 5- HALF_DOWN, 6 - HALF_EVEN

globalConfiguration.name: backdate-penalties-enabled
globalConfiguration.description: If this parameter is disabled penalties will only be added to instalments due moving forward, any old overdue instalments will not be affected.

globalConfiguration.name: paymenttype-applicable-for-disbursement-charges
globalConfiguration.description: Is the Disbursement Entry need to be considering the fund source of the paymnet type

globalConfiguration.name: skip-repayment-on-first-day-of-month
globalConfiguration.description: skipping repayment on first day of month

globalConfiguration.name: change-emi-if-repaymentdate-same-as-disbursementdate
globalConfiguration.description: In tranche loans, if repayment date is same as tranche disbursement date then allow to change the emi amount

globalConfiguration.name: daily-tpt-limit
globalConfiguration.description: Daily limit for third party transfers

globalConfiguration.name: sub-rates
globalConfiguration.description: Enable Rates Module

globalConfiguration.name: loan-reschedule-is-first-payday-allowed-on-holiday
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled, while loan reschedule the first repayment date can be on a holiday/non working day

globalConfiguration.name: account-mapping-for-payment-type
globalConfiguration.description: Asset: default for asset, Use comma seperated values for Liability, Asset and Expense accounts

globalConfiguration.name: account-mapping-for-charge
globalConfiguration.description: Income: default for Income, Use comma seperated values for Income, Liability and Expense accounts

globalConfiguration.name: fixed-deposit-transfer-interest-next-day-for-period-end-posting
globalConfiguration.description: Transfer fixed transfer interest next day(t+1) for period end posting

globalConfiguration.name: allow-backdated-transaction-before-interest-posting
globalConfiguration.description: Avoid retrieving all transactions in a savings account

globalConfiguration.name: allow-backdated-transaction-before-interest-posting-date-for-days
globalConfiguration.description: One time configuration to relax the backdated transactions

globalConfiguration.name: custom-account-number-length
globalConfiguration.description: if enabled, the value if this configuration will set accounnumber length

globalConfiguration.name: random-account-number
globalConfiguration.description: if enabled, the client accounts, saving accounts, loan accounts will be created with Random Account Number

globalConfiguration.name: is-interest-to-be-recovered-first-when-greater-than-emi
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled, when interest amount is greater than EMI, the additional interest is recovered first before principal

globalConfiguration.name: is-principal-compounding-disabled-for-overdue-loans
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled, it donot consider principal of an unpaid installment for calculating interest of next installment. this is for testing back-dated loan schedule

globalConfiguration.name: enable-business-date
globalConfiguration.description: Whether the logical business date functionality is enabled in the system

globalConfiguration.name: enable-automatic-cob-date-adjustment
globalConfiguration.description: Whether the cob date will be automatically recalculated based on the business date

globalConfiguration.name: purge-external-events-older-than-days
globalConfiguration.description: Number of days criteria to purge old external events sent to message channel

globalConfiguration.name: days-before-repayment-is-due
globalConfiguration.description: Number of days before repayment is due to raise event

globalConfiguration.name: days-after-repayment-is-overdue
globalConfiguration.description: Number of days after repayment overdue to raise event

globalConfiguration.name: purge-processed-commands-older-than-days
globalConfiguration.description: Number of days criteria to purge old processed commands

globalConfiguration.name: enable-cob-bulk-event
globalConfiguration.description: Whether bulk event for COB is enabled in the system

globalConfiguration.name: external-event-batch-size
globalConfiguration.description: External event producer batch size

globalConfiguration.name: loan-arrears-delinquency-display-data
globalConfiguration.description: 0 - Both, 1 - Arrears, 2- Delinquency

globalConfiguration.name: charge-accrual-date
globalConfiguration.description: due-date: default for due-date, Use comma seperated values for due-date, submitted-date

globalConfiguration.name: asset-externalization-of-non-active-loans
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled: when a loan state is changed to non-active -> pending transfers will be handled

globalConfiguration.name: next-payment-due-date
globalConfiguration.description: earliest-unpaid-date: default for next-payment-due-date, Use earliest-unpaid-date or next-unpaid-due-date

globalConfiguration.name: enable-payment-hub-integration
globalConfiguration.description: Use payment hub api's for account withdrawal and loan disbursement to linked interop account

globalConfiguration.name: enable-immediate-charge-accrual-post-maturity
globalConfiguration.description: Whether the system creates accruals immediately for charge creation after the maturity date

globalConfiguration.name: password-reuse-check-history-count
globalConfiguration.description: When enabled, prevents password reuse. The value specifies how many previous passwords to check (e.g., 3 = last 3 passwords). Set to 0 to check ALL previous passwords. Disable this setting to allow password reuse.

globalConfiguration.name: force-password-reset-on-first-login
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled, users must reset their password upon first login or after an admin reset. Value is unused.

globalConfiguration.name: allow-force-withdrawal-on-savings-account
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled, allows withdrawals to put the account into negative balance up to the configured limit.

globalConfiguration.name: force-withdrawal-on-savings-account-limit
globalConfiguration.description: The maximum negative balance allowed when force withdrawal is enabled.

globalConfiguration.name: max-login-retry-attempts
globalConfiguration.description: Maximum number of failed login attempts before an account is locked

globalConfiguration.name: allow-cash-and-non-cash-accrual
globalConfiguration.description: When enabled (true), accrual transactions are created at disbursement for None, Cash, and Upfront Accrual accounting types (legacy behavior). When disabled (false), accrual transactions at disbursement are created only for Upfront Accrual accounting type.

globalConfiguration.name: block-transactions-on-closed-overpaid-loans
globalConfiguration.description: If enabled: monetary transactions are blocked on closed and overpaid loan accounts

globalConfiguration.name: last-day-of-financial-year
globalConfiguration.description: 31: default for last day of fiscal year

globalConfiguration.name: last-month-of-financial-year
globalConfiguration.description: 12: default for last month of fiscal year

globalConfiguration.name: income-expense-gl-accounts
globalConfiguration.description: List of income/expense GL account codes for retained earning calculation. Can provide multiple accounts separated by comma or ranges separated by dashes (e.g. 4000,5000-5999,7000). Empty by default, please set before executing job

globalConfiguration.name: retained-gl-account
globalConfiguration.description: Default retained gl account code. Empty by default, please set before executing job

globalConfiguration.name: office-id
globalConfiguration.description: OfficeId for which the report and the retained earning job will be executed

globalConfiguration.name: retained-earning-used-by-report-name
globalConfiguration.stringValue: Trial Balance Summary Report with Asset Owner
globalConfiguration.description: Report name which will be using using retained earning

globalConfiguration.name: outstanding-interest-calculation-strategy-for-external-asset-transfer
globalConfiguration.description: Available options: TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_INTEREST, PAYABLE_OUTSTANDING_INTEREST. Define whether total outstanding interest (due + not yet due + projected) or payable till transfer date ( due + not yet due) should be involved in the asset transfer.

globalConfiguration.name: allowed-loan-statuses-for-external-asset-transfer
globalConfiguration.description: Available options: Any combination from LoanStatus enum separated by comma.

globalConfiguration.name: allowed-loan-statuses-of-delayed-settlement-for-external-asset-transfer
globalConfiguration.description: Available options: Any combination from LoanStatus enum separated by comma.

globalConfiguration.name: enable-instant-delinquency-calculation
globalConfiguration.description: When enabled, allows delinquency evaluation right after monetary transaction processing

globalConfiguration.name: enable-originator-creation-during-loan-application
globalConfiguration.description: When enabled, allows creating new loan originators on-the-fly during loan application if the provided externalId does not exist in the registry
